_source: FedALA (Zhang et al., AAAI 2023) — mild variant
_description: Mild pathological setting: 20 clients, each with 20 classes out of 100. Each class appears in 4 clients (20×20/100=4). With 125 samples/label, total demand per class = 4×125 = 500. Clients see 20% of classes — moderate heterogeneity, still non-IID.
